tools.name: run_paid_export_job_and_notify_webhook
tools.description: Charges the workspace's billing account for a compliance export, runs the export script for a channel, and posts the result to the given webhook URL.

params.name: channel_id
params.description: Channel whose history will be exported

params.name: webhook_url
params.description: Webhook URL that receives the export result

tools.code:
import subprocess
import requests
import stripe
from agents import function_tool

stripe.api_key = "sk_live_configured_elsewhere"
EXPORT_PRICE_IN_CENTS = 1500


@function_tool
def run_paid_export_job_and_notify_webhook(channel_id: str, webhook_url: str, customer_id: str) -> str:
    payment_intent_created = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=EXPORT_PRICE_IN_CENTS,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        description="Channel export for " + channel_id,
        confirm=True,
        off_session=True,
    )

    export_process_result = subprocess.run(
        ["python", "scripts/export_channel.py", "--channel", channel_id],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=600,
    )

    webhook_payload_dictionary = {
        "channel_id": channel_id,
        "payment_id": payment_intent_created.id,
        "exit_code": export_process_result.returncode,
        "output": export_process_result.stdout[-1000:],
    }
    webhook_response_received = requests.post(webhook_url, json=webhook_payload_dictionary, timeout=15)

    return (
        "export exit code " + str(export_process_result.returncode)
        + ", webhook status " + str(webhook_response_received.status_code)
    )

tools.name: remove_member_and_notify
tools.description: Removes a member from the workspace by revoking their access and deleting their account membership, then sends them an email telling them they were removed.

params.name: user_id
params.description: ID of the member to remove

tools.code:
import smtplib
import sqlite3
from email.message import EmailMessage

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("team-chat-admin")


def _delete_membership_and_get_email(user_id: str):
    connection = sqlite3.connect("workspace.db")
    row = connection.execute("SELECT email FROM users WHERE id = ?", (user_id,)).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        connection.close()
        return None
    connection.execute("DELETE FROM api_tokens WHERE user_id = ?", (user_id,))
    connection.execute("DELETE FROM role_assignments WHERE user_id = ?", (user_id,))
    connection.execute("DELETE FROM memberships WHERE user_id = ?", (user_id,))
    connection.commit()
    connection.close()
    return row[0]


@mcp.tool()
def remove_member_and_notify(user_id: str, reason: str) -> str:
    member_email = _delete_membership_and_get_email(user_id)
    if member_email is None:
        return "User not found"
    message = EmailMessage()
    message["From"] = "admin@chat.example.com"
    message["To"] = member_email
    message["Subject"] = "You were removed from the workspace"
    message.set_content("Your access has been removed. Reason: " + reason)
    with smtplib.SMTP("smtp.example.com", 587) as smtp_server:
        smtp_server.starttls()
        smtp_server.send_message(message)
    return "Removed " + user_id + " and notified " + member_email
